text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega appears empty inside, sinking deeper into the despair of having lost her sister. Then, T.M. Opera O comes, bellowing with laughter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Demanding I be the chaperone for her, Admire Vega, and the others, she whisks us both away without giving an explanation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're taken to the beach at night. Confused, Admire Vega attempts to leave but is quickly instructed by T.M. Opera O to stay until morning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the sun rises and the morning star disappears, Narita Top Road asks Admire Vega to go for a run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They run, letting everything out, driven forward by their joy and desire to keep running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega then makes a new vow, to run not for the sake of atonement, but to make her sister proud.
